connector.name: MCP Grafana
connector.registryDescription: An MCP server giving access to Grafana dashboards, data and more.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.grafana.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the container image mcp-grafana:1.0.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the grafana account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-Grafana-URL
headers.description: URL of your Grafana Cloud instance

env.name: GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN
env.description: Service account token used to authenticate with your Grafana instance

env.name: GRAFANA_USERNAME
env.description: Username to authenticate with your Grafana instance

env.name: GRAFANA_PASSWORD
env.description: Password to authenticate with your Grafana instance

env.name: GRAFANA_ORG_ID
env.description: Organization ID for multi-org support. Can also be set via X-Grafana-Org-Id header in SSE/streamable HTTP transports.

env.name: GRAFANA_EXTRA_HEADERS
env.description: JSON object of additional HTTP headers to send with all Grafana API requests

env.name: GRAFANA_FORWARD_HEADERS
env.description: Comma-separated list of HTTP header names to forward from the incoming request to Grafana (SSE/streamable-http only). Example: Cookie,X-Session-Id
